description: Create or update the user's carrier (A2P 10DLC) registration draft. Pass only the fields to change; nested objects merge. Pick registration_type from two questions: has an EIN? (no → sole_proprietor) and more than ~2,000 texts/day? (yes → standard, else low_volume_standard). Business details must match IRS records exactly. Only record consent methods the user actually uses: carriers reject texting purchased or skip-traced lists without consent. write_campaign_text=true then reads their website and drafts the campaign description, opt-in flow and sample messages (needs message_types and consent_channels). Show that text to the user to review.

brand_name.description: Name contacts know them by (DBA). Required for sole proprietors

legal_name.description: Legal business name exactly as on the IRS EIN letter, including LLC/Inc

website_url.description: Live website with a privacy policy; carriers visit it

phone.description: US/Canadian number. For sole proprietors: their personal mobile, never a Spur number

consent_channels.description: How contacts agree to receive texts. Only what the user actually does; never invent consent

message_samples.description: 2–5 samples naming the business; one must include 'Reply STOP to opt out'

opt_in_form_url.description: Required with website_form: the page with the SMS consent checkbox

write_campaign_text.description: true = also draft the campaign text from their website and answers

name: spur_save_texting_registration
title: Save texting registration
